name: Anhui Tuoshan Heavy Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Tuoshan Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. stands as a significant entity within the heavy equipment sector, offering end-to-end solutions from conceptualization and development to the manufacturing, distribution, and after-sales support of essential construction machinery components. Its comprehensive product lineup features a diverse array of forged parts, including track and pin assemblies, bucket teeth, and gear seats. The company also produces gear blocks, track rollers, steering clutch and brake units, and various tensioning mechanisms. Furthermore, its offerings encompass sleeves, shafts, wheels, hydraulic system components, and other vital power transmission elements. This enterprise, which has its headquarters in Xuancheng, China, was established in 1989.
